goal: Remove the verified internal launch blockers before the primary-domain cutover without changing DNS or supplier data.
authorization: Edit, test, push and publish the VII application. Preserve production data, secrets, schedules, permissions and domains. Do not change DNS until the exact candidate passes production verification.

requirements.statement: SPA discovery must return the last accepted bundled snapshot when the runtime generation is temporarily unreadable, while malformed data remains blocked.
requirements.acceptance_check: The focused API test passes and production /api/catalog?world=spa returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty validated catalog.

requirements.statement: Distinguish a runtime publication failure from a supplier API gap and retain the last-good catalog path for every world.
requirements.acceptance_check: Production responses for vacations, events, rooms and spa are recorded with source, fetchedAt and HTTP status after deployment.

requirements.statement: The same release must preserve the temporary host and already-supported primary-host canonical rewrite without changing DNS.
requirements.acceptance_check: Primary-origin stream tests, launch SEO tests, sitemap, robots and llms checks pass; no domain mutation occurs.

requirements.statement: Publish only the exact pushed and tested commit and verify the natural public destination with a retained rollback identity.
requirements.acceptance_check: Build, focused tests, full tests, terminal deployment identity and post-deploy HTTP probes are recorded.

predicted_rejections: SPA still returns a blank state or 503 after deployment.
A fallback hides malformed SPA data instead of validating it.
The release changes DNS or breaks the current temporary host before cutover.
A passing local test is reported as production completion without a live check.
A stale or duplicate deployment is created after an uncertain result.
midpoint_gate: Focused catalog and origin tests pass before the full build and release candidate is pushed.
adversarial_close: Force a database read failure, sample all four production catalogs, verify current and primary-host origin behavior, and reject completion on any 5xx or uncertain deployment.
